purpose: Versioned chronology of mechanics that can alter processing outputs, recipe eligibility, output quality, reagent consumption, and profession statistics. Chronological study assignment is distinct from verified numeric interpolation.

sourceClaims.claim: Gems will now be found more regularly when prospecting Midnight ore.

events.evidenceNotes: Official heading is March 31; cumulative article title April 17 is not event date. Numeric multipliers unspecified. Input/output scope requires identity matching; unknown families are not assumed eligible.

revisionHistory.reason: Blizzard cumulative official hotfix page places prospecting gem change under March 31 heading, not article publication date or prior April 1 estimate.

changeWorkflow: PROPOSE evidence-backed event or revision with exact source claim and date precision
REVIEW scope, game mode, effective dates/build and effect dimensions; preserve earlier revision history and immutable samples
VALIDATE chronology invariants and no unverified numerical model, including as-of event-day ambiguity
RECLASSIFY historical source cohorts by relevant mechanics epochs; never rewrite their original observation records
RECALCULATE only affected baseline/model candidates and confidence estimates with revision provenance
PUBLISH versioned research snapshots only after independent QA; production transformation requires separate validated formula and integration tests
